selection_rule: smallest SHA256 within error class; nearest threshold tie by SHA256
method: TreeSHAP interventional; background from fit only
target: base Random Forest malware probability; not the sigmoid-calibrated p_malware

manifest.note: Exported count describes declaration/default, including disabled components; permission count means some protection, not full access prevention. Enriched booleans do not enter B_core and do not prove activation.

evidence_note: Evidence is static; it does not prove runtime execution.
